# Sensor Calibration Procedures

The salinity sensor array on each buoy is calibrated every 45 days using the
Halcyon reference brine, a sealed calibration standard produced on station.

A salinity drift greater than 0.3 PSU between calibrations marks the sensor
as suspect. Suspect sensors are quarantined from the aggregation feed until a
bench recalibration passes twice consecutively.

Temperature probes follow a different cycle: they are verified monthly
against the dual platinum reference thermometer pair mounted in the wet lab.
